shortDescription: Binance announced on X that crypto red flags include guaranteed returns, pressure to act immediately, requests for verification codes and suspicious reward links. Binance said it will never ask users to share passwords, authentication codes or secret phrases, or to transfer funds to a “safe wallet.”
